regime.basis: Hormuz near-closure (~90%) + Tehran bunker strike + Gulf state direct missile attacks

energy_multiplier.note: Apply 1.5x to position sizing / signal weight for energy-adjacent signals during CRISIS. This is additive over the base regime position-size multiplier — it boosts energy-specific exposure, not general exposure.

hormuz.note: Hormuz closure is a structural supply shock, not a temporary spike. Do NOT fade oil price signals against Hormuz closure as the assumed reversal mechanism. Treat current disruption level as floor; any deterioration is incremental upside to oil.

current_scenario.threat_vector: Iranian drones — 3 intercepted east of Riyadh + Empty Quarter on 2026-03-07
current_scenario.proximity_to_abqaiq: eastern Saudi Arabia, same region as Abqaiq
current_scenario.risk_vs_2019_baseline: HIGHER — 2019 was non-state actor (Houthi); current is direct Iranian military campaign with active war context
current_scenario.probability_estimate: EXTREME — active conflict, demonstrated intent, drone penetration of Saudi air defenses confirmed
current_scenario.recovery_outlook: SLOWER than 2019 — wartime conditions impede repair crews, repeat strikes likely

abqaiq_tail_risk.model_instruction: Do NOT net Abqaiq risk against Venezuela offset. Venezuela 12-18mo lag. Abqaiq is an immediate tail risk.

shock_2.note: Russia massive strike on Ukrainian energy infrastructure 2026-03-07 — European gas/power supply disruption

venezuela_offset.trigger: US-Venezuela diplomatic recognition (2026-03-07) → sanctions relief pathway open but not executed
venezuela_offset.model_instruction: Do NOT net Venezuela offset against current Hormuz or Abqaiq shock in near-term models. Apply only to 12-18mo forward curve.
